hypothesis_source: Every high-takeout breakout on the leader watch list lost to same-day untriggered names at 10/20 days (20d high, rolling 20d high, inside-bar, prior-bar high). Mechanism: on already-strong names, taking out a high is a chase that mean-reverts in the swing window. Remaining trigger in the OS: pullback confirmation. Definition: prior close below MA20, signal close back above MA20. Demand returning after a dip, not a new high.
distinct_from_failed_representations: Not taking out a high. Not all-market launch_pullback_support. Not waiting after a breakout. Not VCP. Difference from high-takeout family: the event is reclaiming the 20-session mean after being below it.

trigger.definition: MA20 is valid_rolling_mean of close over 20 valid bars. Prior session close < prior MA20, signal close > signal MA20. Missing MA20 or prior close does not trigger.

control: Same-day watch-list names without that reclaim.

pass_fail.pass: 10-day and 20-day date-EW net of the reclaim subset is not worse than same-day watch names without the reclaim.
pass_fail.fail: Rewrite only the reclaim event once (mechanistic difference, e.g. hold-above-MA20 then up-close, not a 19/21 MA scan). Stay on the trigger layer. Do not add VCP. Do not reopen high-takeout.
